item.title: [HIGH] Mobile, desktop & browsers: Public exploit code now available for CVE-2026-74936 (Mozilla Firefox)
item.description: A public proof-of-concept or exploit reference was listed for this critical or exploited CVE. PoC repositories are unvetted. — Public attack code lowers the bar for attackers. Expect exploitation attempts to rise; patch ahead of them.
